$Comment: The Essence Infusion: bounty tokens for a pair of one element's essence, three times a day at the General storefront. It pays the Mastery Pack's Mmo_Mastery_Element_Pair table, the materials a Focus's steps ask for, so it exists only beside that pack: the top-level hytale:mod_installed condition on Ziggfreed:MMOSkillMasteryPack keeps the offer off a server without it. It pays no Mastery Point, since those come only from levelling and one-time content. The filename IS this offer's id, and each player's daily and lifetime purchase counts are filed under it, so renaming the file resets those counts for everyone; keep the name as it is.
